manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Shows a tossed ball rising, pausing at the top, and falling under constant downward gravity.
manifest.description: A ball is tossed straight up beside a height scale. As it rises, its upward velocity arrow shortens until it reaches zero at the peak, while a constant downward gravity arrow is always present.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
